claims.statement: Poland made KSeF receipt mandatory from February 2026 and issuance mandatory in phases, while Peppol specifications include invoice-response messages.
Demand hypothesis: accounting channels will pay for shared exception automation because structured invoice transport does not itself resolve commercial mismatches.

contrary_evidence: ERP and accounting vendors can add native KSeF exception tools.
KSeF's structured format may eliminate many basic errors over time.

economics.acquisition_route: Recruit accounting offices and ERP resellers rather than selling entity by entity.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 2000 entities at 250 PLN monthly can create 6 million PLN ARR and founder equity above 5 million PLN in four years.
economics.founder_time: Three hours daily for rules, integrations, and partner support.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 88-94% margin for automated classification and workflow.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 150 entities at 250 PLN monthly recover initial capital within one year.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 150-500 PLN per entity monthly plus 2-8 PLN per resolved exception.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every monthly close produces new invoices, exceptions, and payment follow-up.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Counterparty-specific error mappings and resolution outcomes improve with every invoice.
fingerprint.customer: Polish accounting firms, ERP integrators, and mid-market finance teams.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Accounting offices and ERP resellers embed it across hundreds of client entities.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: The API classifies exceptions, gathers missing evidence, proposes corrections, and records counterparty responses.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The accounting firm or ERP vendor pays per managed entity and resolved exception.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A structured invoice is received but fails validation, matching, acceptance, or payment.

founder_fit: Warsaw and Polish language provide a natural local wedge.
The work is rules-heavy, measurable, and compatible with part-time AI leverage.
risks: Government API changes could raise maintenance cost.
Incorrect correction proposals could create tax or accounting errors.

structure.control_point: The canonical invoice-exception and counterparty-response record.
structure.critical_dependency: Stable KSeF, Peppol, and ERP interfaces.

thesis: A KSeF and Peppol exception layer can diagnose rejected, unmatched, or disputed invoices and coordinate a machine-readable resolution between buyer and supplier.
title: KSeF Invoice Exception Resolver
uncertainties: Paid exception volume per entity is unknown.
